Typhoon Noul (2026): Rapid Report

Lincole Jiang, Majd Abid, Lawrence Chillrud, G. Brooke Anderson, Robbie M. Parks

2026-10-23

Summary

Data status: Provisional — not yet reanalyzed (PROVISIONAL)

Typhoon Noul (2026) was active from 2026-07-23 06:00:00 to 2026-07-26 06:00:00 UTC. Based on IBTrACS data obtained 10/23/2026, 76,138,372 people experienced tropical cyclone-force (>= 17.49 m/s) winds and 5,170,366 people experienced hurricane-force (>= 32.90 m/s) winds across China. No areas experienced Category 5 winds.

Table 1: Population exposed by country and storm intensity
